title: implementation already underway.
columns:
In response to some of the concerns and challenges raised, the Board developed
targeted amendments and a number of proposed clarifications intended to ease
implementation of IFRS 17, simplify some requirements of the standard and ease
transition. The amendments relate to eight areas of IFRS 17, and they are not
intended to change the fundamental principles of the standard or unduly disrupt
implementation already underway.

Annual periods
beginning on or after 1
January 2023
